title: Model SBI as a multi-rail digital-asset group and evaluate bitbank MCP as a public-only XRP/JPY data adapter
decision: Keep XRP distribution, XRP Ledger technical work, JPYSC, OUSD, RLUSD and USDC as separate rails until production transaction evidence demonstrates an actual bridge or settlement relationship.
Record SMFG's 5% participation in SBI Startale Marketing as an official capital relationship; keep the 24M customer-base and JPY20.8B October 30 issuance figures in a secondary-claim class.
Record the SBI Shinsei Trust/SBI Clearing Trust merger as planned for December 31, 2026, not completed; do not infer XRP-specific custody.
Record bitbank's October 1 acquisition as completed and its XRP/JPY liquidity as one third-party snapshot; do not infer post-acquisition volume growth without a pre/post panel.
Treat bitbank-lab-mcp as an experimental local adapter candidate. A Barrot implementation, if later approved, should use public endpoints only with no API keys or private tools.

Preserve raw ticker, order-book, candle and transaction payloads with exchange time, retrieval time, pair, timezone, endpoint, coverage and rate-limit metadata; never convert missing intervals into zero volume.
Recompute Barrot's own features from raw data. Do not import bitbank's composite market-signal score as a calibrated XRP prediction.
Keep private API tools disabled. Do not request trade or withdrawal permissions. The optional MCP Apps _meta execution path remains disabled because its safety premise is host-dependent.
Reconcile tool count (32 versus 33) and release version metadata (0.0.0-dev versus 0.1.1) before pinning a production MCP package.

Keep Claude, Codex and Gemini platform states NOT_TESTED until authenticated request/response, permission review and verifiable evidence handoff occur; documented client compatibility is not live collaboration.
rationale: SBI's official October 30 SMFG alliance, October 29 trust merger, October 1 bitbank acquisition, JPYSC, RLUSD/USDC, XRP rewards, Open Standard and BlackRock exploratory agreement show a multi-rail group strategy rather than one XRP-only architecture.
bitbank-lab-mcp offers potentially useful Japanese XRP/JPY public market data and basic reproducible analytics without credentials, but it is experimental and its docs/manifests contain drift.
The Binance incident and the need to distinguish exchange custody from tradable float make venue-level order-book, trade and candle provenance important.
next_action: Crosswalk Binance's five XRPL source wallets with official October 1 PoR and XRP-BF2 reserve; separately inspect a pinned bitbank MCP release and public XRP/JPY endpoints for a no-key data-quality smoke test.
